Hamleys' rich history began with William Hamley, a Cornishman from Bodmin, England. William Hamley dreamed of the best toy shop in the world when opening his toy shop at Holborn, London in 1760. Hamleys, in India, has grown to be recognized as a trend setter for new and magical experiences for children. The brand has 125+ stores spread across 40 cities in the country and is only growing.

featured_reviews.name: Arocia Raja
featured_reviews.review_text: Price is too high, quality isn't that good, the zips are weak, and they don't give any warrantee or guarantee or anything. The staff is rude. After roaming in the mumbai heat, I went into this shop to buy a bag for my regular travel. One guy just came and stood near the bags hanger and the baby store doorfront, and just stared at me closely as if I am going to steal it. Probably because I was so tanned or something. Else just because I am a women, but I don't have any idea. I recommend not going here. Bags you are seeing here is also available on Amazon for The SAME DAMN PRICE. Just walk away, there is a lots of places in the front.

featured_reviews.name: Mahesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Comfort for kids and Moms is the better shop of locality Mahatma Fule Mandai (Crowfard Market) area which stands at prominent location, in the corner of one sub road and attracts people with its golden shining logo and different lightings highlighting what it sells.
It is right in the middle of marker area and you can see roads flooded with crowd all the time.
Air conditioning makes you feel comfortable as soon as you enter the shop.
The area inside the shop is spacious and it is well arranged.
It sells clothings and other accessories for kids and Moms. It sells branded as well as non branded cloths.
Service is nice and polite.
Price is on little higher side.
More footfalls happen in the evening time hence best time to visit is morning and afternoon hours.
